title: SB 293 (2025-2026 (136th General Assembly)): S. B. No. 293: Revise deadline to return absent voter ballots
operative_text:
(a_in_person_id) not stated.
(b_no_id_remedy) not stated.
(c_mail_ballot_id) not stated.
(d_proof_of_citizenship)
(section) R.C. 3501.01(EE)(1)(a) (new definition)
(quote) (EE)(1) "Proof of citizenship" means evidence that an individual is a United States citizen, in the form of one of the following: (a) The number of the individual's current Ohio driver's license or state identification card, if the secretary of state verifies using information obtained from the bureau of motor vehicles that the individual has submitted documentation to the bureau that indicates that the individual is a United States citizen;
(section) R.C. 3501.01(EE)(1)(b)
(quote) (b) The individual's current Ohio driver's license, state identification card, or interim identification form issued on or after April 7, 2023, or a copy of the front and back of that license, card, or form, if the license, card, or form does not include a notation designating that the individual is a noncitizen of the United States;
(section) R.C. 3501.01(EE)(1)(c)-(e)
(quote) (c) The individual's birth certificate, certification of report of birth, or consular report of birth abroad, or a copy of one of those documents; (d) The individual's current United States passport or passport card, a copy of the identification page of the passport, or a copy of the front and back of the passport card; (e) The individual's certificate of naturalization or certificate of citizenship or a copy of one of those documents;
(section) R.C. 3503.152(A) (citizenship check against BMV data and SAVE)
(quote) The secretary of state shall conduct reviews of the statewide voter registration database on at least a monthly basis to identify persons who are not United States citizens by consulting the following sources: (1) Information the secretary of state obtains from the bureau of motor vehicles under section 3503.151 of the Revised Code; (2) The systematic alien verification for entitlements (SAVE) program, or its successor program, operated by the United States department of homeland security or its successor agency.
(section) R.C. 3503.152(B)
(quote) Following each review conducted under this section, the secretary of state shall do both of the following: (1) Send a report to each board of elections of each person in the county who, according to the databases described in division (A) of this section, is not a United States citizen. The board promptly shall cancel the person's voter registration in accordance with section 3503.21 of the Revised Code. (2) Direct the election integrity unit to conduct a further investigation regarding each such person under section 3501.055 of the Revised Code.
(section) R.C. 3505.18(A)(3)
(quote) (3) If the elector provides photo identification in the form of the elector's Ohio driver's license, state identification card, or interim identification form and the photo identification includes a notation designating that the individual is a noncitizen of the United States, the election officials shall challenge the elector's right to vote under division (A) of section 3505.20 of the Revised Code.
(section) R.C. 3505.20(A) (challenge at the polls)
(quote) (2) Do you possess proof of your United States citizenship? Please provide that documentation. If the person offering to vote produces proof of citizenship for inspection of the precinct election officials, other than the number of the person's Ohio driver's license or state identification card, and declares under oath that the person is a citizen of the United States, the person shall be permitted to cast a regular ballot.
(section) R.C. 3505.183(B)(3)(i) (provisional ballot counts only if proof given within four days)
(quote) (i) If applicable, the individual provided proof of citizenship on the provisional ballot affirmation or within four days after the day of the election.
(e_other_rule)
(section) R.C. 3503.201(A)(1) (new section; provisional ballot after data mismatch)
(quote) (A)(1) When either of the following occur, the board of elections shall send the elector a confirmation notice and, if the board's records are not already so marked, shall mark the elector's registration record, the official registration list, and the poll list or signature pollbook to indicate that the elector must vote by provisional ballot and the reason the elector must do so:
(section) R.C. 3503.151(E) (date of birth, ID number and SSN4 matching)
(quote) (E) The secretary of state shall use the information in the statewide voter registration database and the databases of the bureau of motor vehicles and the United States social security administration to provide information to each board of elections that identifies each voter registration record in the county in which the elector's date of birth or Ohio driver's license or state identification card number or the last four digits of the elector's social security number does not match the information in the database of the bureau of motor vehicles or the United States social security administration for purposes of section 3503.201 of the Revised Code.
(other) 3503.21: adds cancellation of registration for a secretary-of-state report of noncitizenship and other listed reasons.
(other) 3503.18: monthly deaths report to boards now also draws on SAVE and other sources.
(other) 3503.19, 3503.21: undeliverable registration notices now follow new 3503.201.
(other) 3503.13: elector's proof of citizenship is kept out of public disclosure.
(other) 3505.182, 3505.183, 3505.181: provisional ballot affirmation and counting rules add proof-of-citizenship and data-mismatch cure steps; challenge cure period cut from seven to four days.
(other) 3509.05(D): absentee ballots must reach the board by the close of polls on Election Day; the postmark grace period (ballots arriving up to four days later) is struck.
(other) 3517.14: Ohio Election Integrity Commission membership rules (who may serve).
(other) version: 00_IN: only the absentee-ballot return deadline (3509.05, 3511.09, 3511.11); no ID or citizenship text.
(other) version: 01_RS and 02_PS: only the 3509.05 return-deadline change; no ID or citizenship text.
(other) version: 03_RH: House substitute adds all slot d text (proof-of-citizenship definition, monthly SAVE/BMV citizenship checks, challenge and provisional ballot rules) plus 3503.201 data-mismatch provisional ballots and the Election Integrity Commission membership change.
(other) version: 04_PH and 05_EN: same ID/citizenship text as 03_RH.
(other) note: Slot quotes from amended sections are the resulting words (struck words removed, unchanged words kept). Slots a-c: the bill reprints the existing photo-ID rules in 3505.18 and 3505.181 unchanged apart from the new 3505.18(A)(3). Citizenship check (3503.152): everyone on the roll is checked at least monthly against BMV data and SAVE; only people flagged as non-citizens are reported to boards, which then cancel the registration and the election integrity unit investigates. People who are not flagged are not asked for proof. Proof of citizenship is requested when a voter is challenged at the polls, shows a license marked noncitizen, or is told to provide proof via provisional ballot. Senate passage (2025-11-05) was on the Senate committee version (01_RS), which has no ID text.
